Inconel718.notes: Inconel 718 (UNS N07718). Industry standard for sour-service downhole tool housings. Resistant to H2S/CO2 at 150C.
Inconel718.justification: Pre-qualified under NACE MR0175/ISO 15156-3 Annex for CRA use in sour environments. Non-magnetic, maintains yield strength at 150C, immune to SSC/HIC in H2S up to 25%.

SS316.notes: Stainless Steel 316L (UNS S31603). Budget structural casing for mild environments only.
SS316.standard: NACE MR0175 / ISO 15156-3 (limited to low H2S partial pressure, solution annealed, max 22 HRC)
SS316.justification: Conditionally compliant under NACE MR0175 only when solution-annealed and hardness-controlled. NOT recommended for >3% H2S environments.

Titanium.notes: Titanium alloy Ti-6Al-4V (UNS R56400, Grade 5). Lightweight, high strength-to-weight, non-magnetic.
Titanium.standard: NACE MR0175 / ISO 15156-3, ASTM B265, AMS 4928
Titanium.justification: Listed in NACE MR0175/ISO 15156-3 for sour service. Preferred for acoustic tools due to favorable acoustic impedance and lightweight construction.

PEEK.notes: Polyether ether ketone (Victrex PEEK 450G). Industry standard for downhole electronics chassis, connectors, and sensor housings.
PEEK.standard: ISO 1183 (density), ISO 22007-4 (thermal conductivity). No NACE requirement (non-metallic).
PEEK.justification: De facto industry standard thermoplastic for downhole electronics. Continuous service temperature 260C, excellent chemical resistance to drilling fluids, electrical isolation properties.

Microporous.notes: Microporous insulation (Promat Microtherm 1000R). Industry standard for space-constrained high-temp thermal barriers in downhole tools.
Microporous.justification: Thermal conductivity 4x lower than conventional insulation at equivalent thickness. Rigid panel form ideal for annular gaps in cylindrical tool housings.

Aerogel.notes: Silica Aerogel Composite (e.g., Aspen Aerogels Pyrogel). Extreme thermal insulation in flexible blanket form.
Aerogel.justification: Lowest thermal conductivity of any commercially available solid insulation. Hydrophobic. Flexible blanket form conforms to complex geometries.

PTFE.notes: Polytetrafluoroethylene (Teflon, DuPont). Chemically inert, easy to machine. Good thermal insulation.
PTFE.standard: ASTM D4894 / D4895 (PTFE molding and extrusion materials)
PTFE.justification: Universally used in oilfield for seals due to extreme chemical inertness. Service temperature up to 260C. Poor acoustic coupling limits use in acoustic tool designs.

Vacuum_Gap.notes: Approximated vacuum gap for Dewar flask (effective conductivity accounts for thermal radiation).
Vacuum_Gap.standard: Industry standard for HPHT thermal flasks

Thermal_Mass_CuBe.notes: Copper-Beryllium alloy. High thermal mass buffer to absorb heat leakage.
Thermal_Mass_CuBe.justification: Provides immense thermal inertia compared to PEEK, delaying internal temperature rise.
